summary.headline: Regency Fincorp H1 FY27 PAT rose 146% to INR16.3 crore; AUM reached INR610.25 crore and FY27 PAT guidance raised to INR40-42 crore.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 total income was INR32.44 crore (up 240% YoY) and PAT was INR9.01 crore (up 170.37% YoY). H1 FY27 total income of about INR49.5-49.87 crore and PAT of INR16.3 crore both already exceeded full-year FY26 levels. AUM reached INR610.25 crore at 30 September 2026, and management revised FY27 AUM guidance to INR900-950 crore and PAT guidance to INR40-42 crore. The company announced a proposed preferential issue of about INR312-313 crore to fund acquisitions of a digital lending platform and a gold loan business, with asset quality (GNPA 0.99%, NNPA 0.75%) reported within target range.

segments.name: Secured MSME lending
segments.commentary: Secured book of about INR452 crore (Q&A: INR410-420 crore) with cumulative disbursement of about INR252 crore across 2,366 active loans. Average ticket size INR50-55 lakh, possibly rising to INR75 lakh; target 70-75% of book.

segments.name: Digital lending (CashMySalary)
segments.commentary: H1 FY27 disbursement of INR125 crore, more than 87,000 active loans across about 15,000 pin codes and 25-26 states. Short-tenure (90-day) salary-linked product; target 20-25% of book, capped at 30%.

segments.name: JetFund
segments.commentary: Newly launched digital instant salary advance and personal loan product, ticket size INR20,000 to INR1 lakh. Targeting AUM of INR50-55 crore by March 2027.

segments.name: Regency Fintech subsidiary
segments.commentary: Booked about INR14 crore revenue in Q2 with about INR1 crore profit contribution; management says it builds digital lending tech infrastructure and charges a nominal fee, with no revenue-sharing model. Regency Pay awaiting RBI licence, expected this quarter.

guidance_outlook: FY27 AUM target revised to INR900-950 crore (earlier about INR600 crore), against INR610.25 crore at Sep 2026.
FY27 PAT target revised to INR40-42 crore or higher (earlier INR35-40 crore); management called it '100% achievable'.
Blended borrowing cost target of 10.75-11.25% by March 2027, with management also citing 11.5%; further 100 bps reduction expected.
AUM projections of INR2,000 crore in FY28 and INR3,000 crore in FY29, subject to acquisitions.
Leverage ceiling of 3.5-4x debt-to-equity, with conservative target of 3-3.2x.
Net worth expected to rise to INR290 crore by March 2027 and about INR615 crore by March 2028 after full preferential issue.
capex_capacity: Proposed preferential issue of about INR312-313 crore (equity plus warrants), approved by Board on 16 Oct 2026, with corporate, AIF and fund-house commitments.
INR100-125 crore to acquire a digital lending platform (100% stake), staged over 3-9 months; internal metrics done for one target, the other under independent due diligence.
Up to INR75 crore to acquire a majority (over 50%) stake in a gold loan company, expected over 3-4 months; two candidates evaluated.
Expanded tech and digital team; moved into a large office in Noida; headcount of 390 employees.
Possible four hub-and-spoke digital centres (Noida plus Bangalore, east and west India) subject to capacity build-out.
demand_pricing: Management says the secured book is about 70% of portfolio with LTV around 60% and collateral cover above 100%.
Digital book is limited to salaried customers (2 years ITR, 6+ months tenure, six salaries received).
Digital customer retention reported at 70%; company says in-house digital marketing lowers vendor costs versus associates.
Competition: management says NBFC peers run debt-to-equity of 4.5-5x versus Regency's 2.66x.

qa_highlights.question: Is the rise in GNPA to 0.99% driven by mix or specific segment stress, and what safeguards exist against the targets of GNPA below 1.25% and NNPA below 1%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said gross NPA is about INR6.2 crore, with asset-backed recovery of INR2.5-2.75 crore expected, and saw no foreseen stress. Secured book is being pushed to 75% with LTV around 60%, and the digital book is limited to salaried borrowers.

qa_highlights.question: How much headroom is there on leverage, and what is the optimal debt-to-equity?
qa_highlights.answer: Management targets a leverage ceiling of 3.5-4x, conservative 3-3.2x, versus 2.66x now. Preferential equity adds about INR100 crore to net worth of INR189.55 crore.

qa_highlights.question: What drives the cost of funds decline and the FY27 revenue and PAT guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: Blended borrowing cost fell from 13.5% to 12.35% in six months, with a further 100 bps targeted by March 2027. Revised PAT guidance of INR40-42 crore reflects AUM growth and the acquisitions adding revenue later.

qa_highlights.question: What are the Regency Fintech subsidiary's revenue and cost structure, and any related-party link to the digital platform acquisition?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the subsidiary builds tech infrastructure and charges a nominal fee passed between balance sheets, with no revenue-sharing model. The target platform is a third party generating about INR2 crore profit per month and is an arm's-length deal.

qa_highlights.question: How will the preferential proceeds be used, and will any go to lender repayment?
qa_highlights.answer: INR100-125 crore goes to the digital platform, up to INR75 crore to the gold loan stake, and the balance to MSME and digital lending growth plus general corporate purposes. Management said no proceeds will go to repay lenders, since repayments come from the portfolio.

qa_highlights.question: What is the AUM trajectory from FY27 to FY29 and the AUM growth between FY26 and FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: AUM rose from INR290-294 crore at March 2026 to INR610 crore, with growth from new borrowers, including INR125 crore in digital disbursement. Management projects INR2,000 crore in FY28 and INR3,000 crore in FY29.

risks_watch: Acquisitions (digital platform and gold loan) are subject to approvals and due diligence; revenue contribution from the gold loan business is expected mainly in FY28.
Related-party question on Regency Fintech was answered qualitatively; no quantified intercompany fee or cost breakdown was disclosed.
Regency Pay licence from RBI is pending and expected in the current quarter.
Asset quality: GNPA rose to 0.99% against a target below 1.25%; watch digital and secured book slippages.
Rising leverage on a 2.66x base, with dependence on preferential issue completion.
Q2 PAT is reported as INR9.01 crore in one place and INR9.3 crore in another; the figure needs reconciliation against the filed results.
summary.management_tone: Confident and assertive, with strong forward targets (AUM, PAT and FY28-29 projections). Less precise under questioning: related-party and subsidiary economics were answered qualitatively, and several figures were inconsistent across answers.
key_quotes: Our assets under management stood at INR610.25 crores as of 30th September 2026.
We are targeting an AUM of approximately INR900 crores to INR950 crores by the end of the financial year 2027.
The net interest margin increased to 7.54% in H1 FY2027 from 3.51% in H1 FY2026, supported by a high-yield portfolio mix and a lower blended cost of funds.

Our revised numbers of INR900 crores to INR950 crores of AUM and profitability of between INR40 crores to INR42 crores of northwards should be 100% achievable with the numbers that we are putting across.
